positions.recommendation: QB is the top scoring position in the current sample. Quarterbacks are elite in spike weeks, but the position has fewer high-volume players. Streaming or waiting on QB can still be a winning strategy in shallow or competitive leagues.

RB scores at 51% of the best position average. In most redraft leagues, RB offers the strongest weekly production depth and is a strong draft target. It should be prioritized early if your league rewards volume and consistency.

WR scores at 40% of the best position average. In most redraft leagues, WR offers the strongest weekly production depth and is a strong draft target. It should be prioritized early if your league rewards volume and consistency.

TE scores at 27% of the best position average. Tight ends can outperform their draft slot when the matchup is favorable, but they have the least weekly depth. This is a good sleeper or late-round strategy if your league values matchup upside.
